purpose: Top navigation for every pack: the pack's own stop treatment, search, the household and the gear. Home, Movies and Series are always present; Games and Live TV are doors the host draws only when the household installed those add-ons.

anatomy.note: Wordmark or brand disc; on Apple/Netflix/Classic it is also the Home stop.
Home, Movies, Series, then Games and Live TV only when installed, in that order.
Should be a knob/dot at the end of the pill, never an afterthought at the far edge.
Profile disc plus Settings gear; gear is the last stop.

geometry.bandHeight: 96dp on classic packs; pack nav band token on Glass/Kids/PS5

copy.liveLabelIsShort: Packs that draw a four-word pill may shorten Live TV to Live; the content description stays 'Live TV'.

rules: LEFT at the first stop stops there (or opens the rail on packs that own one); it never wraps.
RIGHT at the last stop stops there.
DOWN from any stop returns to the top of the shelves.
UP from the hero/shelves lands on the stop of the section the viewer is standing in, not at the far end.

behaviour: An active stop is a brighter ink/plate, never a coloured brand fill that fights the pack's focus language.
A stop is present only when its destination exists: Games needs an enabled games add-on, Live TV needs the live add-on and a playlist.
Switching section rebuilds the page; the bar never changes shape mid-walk.
The bar fades with the chrome where a pack scrolls the hero under it; it returns on any key or when focus reaches it.

platformDeltas.ios: Same order and copy; household becomes the leading avatar, settings moves to the trailing end. No hover; pressed state uses the same active plate.
platformDeltas.windows: Keyboard LEFT/RIGHT mirrors the remote; add a visible focus ring and mouse hover only on the pointer, not on TV.
platformDeltas.apple-tv: Focus lift replaces the ring; keep the same order and gated stops.

a11y.label: Primary navigation
a11y.contrast: active and idle ink each >= 4.5:1 against the pill
